Built for this platform

What you can do with Pinterest Ads MCP

01

Follow spend through to checkouts

Report on paid impressions, outbound clicks, checkout counts, and checkout value where available. Normalized conversions represent checkouts, not every Pinterest event.

02

Inspect campaign structure

List campaigns including draft and archived entities. Reporting supports account, campaign, ad-group, and ad levels without pretending campaign creation builds Pins or child ad groups.

03

Adjust CBO budgets safely

Preview daily or lifetime campaign budget changes while retaining the existing budget type. Lifetime creation requires an end time; flexible daily and non-CBO updates are not treated as ordinary caps.

Know what the data means

Synchronous reports use a maximum 90-day range and lookback. Current normalization uses 30-day click and 1-day view attribution at ad-action time. Unsupported dates or budget modes are rejected rather than silently changed.

Local setup · Bring your own credentials

Connect Pinterest Ads to Claude Code or Cursor.

The npm CLI and MCP server run on your machine. You need Node.js 22.13 or newer, your own provider credentials, and permission to access the ad account.

01 Install Adport

npm install -g adport

02 Connect Pinterest Ads

adport connect pinterest

The wizard completes OAuth and verifies ad-account discovery before replacing local credentials. Refresh-token rotation is persisted for store-backed connections.

03 Check your connection

adport doctor
adport accounts --provider pinterest

Check that the intended account appears before asking your agent to report on it. Never paste tokens, client secrets, or private keys into chat.

Before you connect

  • Your own approved Pinterest developer app. Trial access is for testing; external-user onboarding requires the appropriate access level.
  • The exact redirect URI http://localhost:53686/callback registered on the app.
  • Your client ID and PINTEREST_CLIENT_SECRET supplied securely. The connection requests ads:read and ads:write.
Full Pinterest Ads connection guideOfficial Pinterest Ads API documentation

Adport is independent and is not endorsed by Pinterest Ads. Provider access and approval are separate from installing this package.

Use Pinterest Ads from your agent.

Pinterest Ads in Claude Code

After connecting locally, register Adport as a stdio MCP server:

claude mcp add --transport stdio adport -- adport mcp

Start a new session and ask Claude to list your connected Pinterest Ads accounts.

Claude Code MCP documentation

Pinterest Ads in Cursor

Add this entry to your Cursor MCP configuration. Merge it with existing servers rather than replacing them:

{
  "mcpServers": {
    "adport": {
      "command": "adport",
      "args": [
        "mcp"
      ]
    }
  }
}

The command must be available on Cursor’s PATH. Enable the server and ask the agent to inspect your account.

You stay in control

A suggestion is not a live change.

The first mutation call returns a preview and a short-lived pending-operation token. Applying requires that token and the same arguments. Budget caps and protected accounts are checked by the policy engine; new campaigns are paused by policy.

Local operations are recorded in an append-only audit log. An approved preview is not a guarantee of provider acceptance, and a connected agent does not grant additional account permissions.

Pinterest Ads MCP questions

Can this Pinterest MCP create Pins and a complete campaign?

The connector supports guarded CBO campaign creation, status, and budget operations. That does not create Pins, creatives, targeting, or child ad groups. Those pieces are outside this module’s current authoring surface.

Can I use Pinterest Ads locally without Adport Cloud?

Yes. Install Adport from npm, connect your own Pinterest Ads credentials, and register the local MCP server with a stdio-compatible agent such as Claude Code or Cursor. Your provider may have its own approval, access, or billing requirements.

Why can I connect an account but not read a report or apply a change?

Account discovery, reporting, and mutations can require different permissions. Check the requested account, provider app scopes, advertiser eligibility, and environment. Start with adport doctor and the connection guide above. Do not bypass a denied operation by sharing secrets with the agent.
